Exercise: STRAIGHT-ARM LAT PULLDOWN bottom position. Standing facing a single high cable tower, feet hip width, knees softly bent, small hip hinge with neutral spine. Both closed OVERHAND hands shoulder width on one short straight bar near FRONT upper thighs. Elbows almost straight with small natural bend; arms run downward forward of torso. One continuous taut cable from bar CENTER up to high front pulley, never through head or torso. Rear-side three-quarter view shows lats, bar in front, cable connection, full tower. Coral latissimus muscle bellies only, not central spine or arms.

revisions.reason: Cable clip did not clearly connect to bar
revisions.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image1 edit target, image2 canonical style reference. Correct ONLY cable/bar/hand contact in this straight-arm pulldown. Move the short straight bar slightly forward from thighs to show both overhand hands spaced shoulder-width. The single cable must connect via a visible steel swivel eyelet at the EXACT MIDDLE of the bar BETWEEN the hands. The clip must physically touch this center eyelet; no suspended gap and no cable attached to a hand or wrist. Show both grips clearly on either side of midpoint. Keep almost straight elbows and downward-forward arms, small hip hinge, full tower, lats-only coral, same original mannequin, palette, shorts/shoes, background and light.

revisions.reason: Revision detached near hand from forearm
revisions.prompt: Image1 EDIT TARGET has a concrete anatomy error: the rightmost hand gripping the bar is DETACHED from its arm, while the near forearm terminates at center cable collar. Repair ONLY this: shift/re-angle the mannequin's visible near forearm so its wrist continuously joins that RIGHTMOST hand. Keep this near elbow almost straight. The bar center must contain only METAL cable swivel, no wrist, no skin. Final exactly two arms ending in exactly two gripping hands, both on bar on opposite sides of cable midpoint. Keep other far arm/hand, bar and cable, character identity from image2, equipment and composition unchanged.

revisions.reason: Two bar edits failed wrist anatomy; regenerate valid rope variant

Exercise: STRAIGHT-ARM LAT PULLDOWN with ROPE attachment, near bottom of pull. Mannequin faces a single cable tower with high pulley. Stand hip width, slight forward hip hinge, knees soft. Both arms extend downward and forward with almost straight elbows. Each closed neutral hand grips one black rope end, hands just outside upper thighs. Rope forms an inverted Y: two clear strands rise from hands to single shared center junction ahead of abdomen, center junction connects via metal carabiner to taut cable leading diagonally up to HIGH tower pulley.
